findings.description: The KMS key omits `enable_key_rotation`, so automatic annual key rotation is disabled. For an audit-bucket encryption key this means the same cryptographic material is used indefinitely, widening the window in which a compromised or leaked key material remains usable and preventing routine re-keying of protected audit data.

`deletion_window_in_days = 7` sets the shortest window AWS permits (the AWS/Terraform default is 30 days). This shortens the recovery period after a key deletion is scheduled, reducing the ability to detect and reverse a malicious or accidental deletion of the key that protects audit data.
